title: First customer controlled write gate
purpose: Create or verify exactly one first customer only after TARGET-036B proved the Customer Card route with Vorlage anwenden visible but not clicked.
entryCriteria: TARGET-036B result exists and routeSummary.customers is card-with-apply-template-action.
Business Central context is playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
Customer Card Page 21 shows Nr., Name and Vorlage anwenden before any write.
stopIf: The active instance is not playthru.
The active company is not UNIVERSAARL-DE.
Customer Card route is not visible or not safely closable.
Vorlage anwenden would be required before the field list is understood.
A vendor, item, document, Preview Posting or Posting route appears.
A save/confirm dialog appears with unclear effect.
acceptanceCriteria: At most one customer is created or verified.
Before/after/reopen screenshots show the customer route and visible result.
No vendor or item is created.
No template is applied unless a nested Smart Decision explicitly approves it.
No setup, document, Preview Posting, Posting, Payment, API shortcut or company switch occurs.
Result JSON states which fields were changed and which remained untouched.

nextStepDecisionCard.lastEvidenceSummary: TARGET-036A created or verified Location SAAR-HL with Code and Name only and reopen proof.
nextStepDecisionCard.reason: Customer, Vendor and Item records are accounting-relevant and can trigger templates or mandatory fields; New routes must be classified before saving records.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: Customer write can be prepared only with explicit field/template gates.
Vendor write should wait until customer route proves the shared template pattern.
Item creation needs inventory/posting/unit/template field gates before a saved item.
Parked Page 314, VAT matrix, inventory posting and default-dimension blockers remain relevant before first document flow.
Preview requires real master data, accepted setup boundaries and expected entry traces.

nextStepDecisionCard.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: Customer is the next smallest accounting master-data write; Vendor and Item remain behind additional gates.
risksBeforeNextCase: A future write case must not click Vorlage anwenden / Apply Template blindly.
List/card visibility is not posting readiness.
Item creation is riskier than customer/vendor because it touches inventory and product posting groups.
requiredPreparation: Define exact field list for the first saved customer, including whether Vorlage anwenden is needed.
Keep vendor and item writes locked until their own Smart Decision cards exist.
